in_hebrew.name: עבנה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Abena can be translated as 'breath' or 'breath of life'. It is derived from the Hebrew root word 'avar' (אובר), which means 'to breathe'. The name Abena can be seen as a reminder of the breath of life that God breathed into Adam, giving him the gift of life.

in_greek.name: Αβένα
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Abena is derived from the Greek word 'anemos' (ανέμος), which means 'wind' or 'breeze'. The name Abena can be translated as 'breath' or 'wind', reflecting the idea of the breath of life that is essential for sustaining life.

in_latin.name: Abena
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Abena is a Latinization of the Greek name Αβένα. It can be translated as 'breath' or 'life', reflecting the idea of the breath of life that is essential for sustaining life.
